responsibility: Provides the knowledge base and deferred diagnostics used to suggest missing standard-library #include directives. It maps common C and C++ library names and string-format macros to likely headers based on the active language standard, and implements suggest_missing_header so later diagnostics can attach include fix-it hints and explanatory notes when an undeclared identifier likely comes from a known header.
same_name_distinction: Implements the known-header database and behavior: it stores the C/C++ name-to-header tables, performs dialect-sensitive lookup, and defines suggest_missing_header's constructor/destructor that emit include fix-it diagnostics, whereas known-headers.h only exposes that API and class declaration.
